THINGS SERIES (PART 2)
G1985-33 (SERIES 5)

GEORGIA STATE UNIVERSITY LIBRARY
ATLANTA, GEORGIA
Unscanned Negatives in the Lane Brothers Collection Things Series, Part 2
Special Collections and Archives, Georgia State University Library
NOTE
The Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers Photographic Collection consists of about 258,100 (196,800 4x5 inch and 61,300 2 1/2 inch) acetate negatives which are housed in 43,486 envelopes. The collection spans the years 1920 to 1976 with the bulk of the negatives dating from 1939 to 1975. Some of the images are copy negatives of photographs which date as early as 1864.
This inventory describes the contents of one of the 6 series of the Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers Photographic Collection. This document was created to optimize searching the collection’s contents in Georgia State University Library’s Digital Collections.
This is the second of 2 inventories listing the envelopes containing negatives in the Lane Collection Things series from which no digital scans have been made as of April 2012. Though new scans will be added to the Digital Collections as an ongoing project, this inventory will not be updated. Please contact Georgia State University Library Special Collections and Archives to learn more.

Special Collections and Archives, Georgia State University Library
Extent
The Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers photographic collection Things series consists of over 4880 envelopes containing 4 x5 inch black-and-white negatives, housed in 31 boxes.
Biographical note
J. H. (Jack) Lane (1889-1970) began work as a freelance photographer for the Atlanta News in 1914. He and his brother W. C. Lane (1885-1964) founded the Lane Brothers Photo News Service, in which they were later joined by their sons, J. D. (Dan) and W. C., Jr. After the 1939 demise of the News' successor, the Atlanta Georgian, they established their own studio, Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers. One of the leading photographic firms in Atlanta, it closed circa 1980.
Scope and content
The collection consists of photographic negatives and prints created by Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers. The Things series contains images of a variety of events, people, and objects.
System of arrangement
Negatives are organized in alphabetically arranged envelopes by topic. For most of the envelopes, topics were assigned during processing at Georgia State University Library as indicated by brackets. Some titles indicate the client or event as noted by Lane Brothers Commercial Photographers.
Conditions governing access
Unrestricted access.
Source of acquisition
Acquired from Jack Daniel Lane, Jr., in 1985.
